verification_method: For each local CSV, normalize CRLF line endings to LF, then compute the Git blob SHA-1 (SHA-1 of 'blob <byte-count>\0<content>'); compare it with the GitHub blob at the pinned commit.
result: All eight local files exactly match the pinned upstream file contents after CRLF-to-LF normalization.
interpretation_boundary: This establishes the identity of the copied VoT repository artifacts only. It does not establish the original publisher, raw source URL, target definition, units, transformations, or historical data release lineage.
line_ending_audit: All local files use CRLF only, one CRLF per physical line. The upstream Git blobs are LF-normalized; local-minus-upstream byte count equals the physical line count for every file.
